## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical I/O isolation for multi-tenant workloads, including per-tenant quotas, choice of scheduler, and micro-benchmark validation.

## Key Concepts
- cgroups v2 io.max/io.weight
- IO schedulers: BFQ, Kyber, mq-deadline
- NUMA awareness and CPU pinning
- per-tenant storage pools and monitoring

